title: Zero-fuel docked watch: a scout already docked at Ironlight Refuge, GSC-0026 ([IRLC], a partner's station) saves its order book and mission board every 5 minutes for 30 minutes
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-24 05:15 UTC (orders ENT-085, P1 and block ORACLE: the newborns' home regions; rule F8). The Outer Rim scouts stand docked here between region reads when every list of theirs reads all its systems within its cadence (fill.py status scout, 05:13 UTC: census-region-altais, census-far-1, census-east and census-roads `every system read`); this watch gives a docked scout zero-fuel work with an output: fresh book readings and the mission board for Trade and Logistics. A copy of watch-book-cargo-lanes: one ship a station, since a second reads the same book; only a scout already in this system takes it (requires.in_system). Standing work, never judged on its pay (F22). The book of a partner faction's fixed station ([IRLC], neutral by agreement, rules sec 14; Civitas beside it is a mobile station and is not named): read, never traded from here, which is Trade's work.
